summary: The three most noticeable problems are: (1) the skirt/petticoat bunching up into the forearms and sleeves in cross_legged; (2) the sleeves merging into a single bulky mass across the chest in hug_self; and (3) the skirt/petticoat holding a rigid, widely exposed underside around the thighs in sit_chair, jump_tuck, lie_back_elbows and sit_stand, most evident at frames 36–60. The third problem is substantially attributable to the stated absence of cloth physics and is generally minor in this review. No unequivocal tearing, exploding geometry, reversed joints or severe limb stretching is visible. Ratings cover the supplied views and sampled frames; they cannot establish smoothness or rule out intersections in the intervening frames.

items.name: sit_chair
items.location: Skirt front and sides surrounding the seated thighs
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat retain a broad, bowl-like shape instead of settling over the thighs, visibly exposing the underside, although this is largely expected without cloth physics and clear body penetration is not established.

items.name: seiza
items.location: Front hem around the knees and folded lower legs
items.issue: The front skirt stays lifted around the knees and the side view shows a stiff shelf over the folded legs, consistent with the unsimulated cloth chains rather than an obvious joint failure.

items.name: kneel_one
items.issue: The raised thigh carries a large section of skirt upward as a rigid panel, leaving an exaggerated open underside, but the visible knee and leg remain anatomically readable.

items.name: cross_legged
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat rise into tall folds against the forearms and visibly merge with the sleeve silhouettes, especially in the three-quarter view, producing a clearly tangled garment arrangement even allowing for absent physics.

items.name: deep_lunge
items.location: Skirt above the forward thigh and between the legs
items.issue: The skirt lifts as a broad, stiff canopy above the forward thigh rather than folding locally around the lunge, an expected limitation of the unsimulated cloth.

items.name: run_l
items.location: Bent knee and skirt above the lifted thigh
items.issue: The three-quarter view shows a somewhat pinched, angular bend at the lifted knee together with a stiff skirt shelf, but no substantial limb stretching or definite garment penetration.

items.name: run_r
items.location: Bent knee and skirt above the lifted thigh
items.issue: The lifted knee has a slightly compressed bend and the skirt follows the raised thigh in a broad rigid section, both small artifacts at this scale.

items.name: jump_tuck
items.location: Skirt and petticoat in front of the tucked thighs
items.issue: The skirt and petticoat form a nearly continuous rigid disk in front of the tucked legs, an obvious cloth simplification compatible with the stated lack of physics rather than clear tearing or body penetration.

items.name: high_kick
items.issue: A large skirt section rotates upward with the kicking leg as a stiff panel, while the visible limb remains plausible and the sheets do not establish a clear through-body intersection.

items.name: arms_crossed
items.location: Overlapping sleeves in front of the chest
items.issue: The puffed sleeves compress into a broad shared silhouette with little visible contact folding, suggesting a small sleeve overlap while the crossed-arm pose remains readable.

items.name: hands_on_hips
items.issue: The cuffs disappear abruptly into the waist/skirt silhouette and obscure the hands, making the contact look slightly embedded rather than showing a clear hand resting on each hip.

items.name: hug_self
items.location: Sleeves across the chest and opposite upper arms
items.issue: The two sleeves visually merge into a single angular, shield-like mass across the chest, losing the separate arm contours and producing a conspicuous garment collision.

items.name: lie_back_elbows
items.location: Skirt and petticoat over the extended thighs
items.issue: The hem remains propped into a large open bowl around the thighs instead of settling with the reclined body, largely explainable by absent cloth physics without a definite visible through-body intersection.

items.name: dance_heart
items.location: Hands against the crown and front hair
items.issue: The hands overlap the crown/front-hair silhouette closely enough to appear slightly embedded, although the sheet does not resolve whether this is actual penetration or tight contact.

items.name: run
items.location: Bent knees, especially in the three-quarter row
items.issue: The flexed knees become slightly pinched and angular at the tighter bends, without clear severe volume loss, reversed bending or a confirmed discontinuity between the sampled frames.

items.name: turn
items.issue: The ankles and shoes converge into a compressed, difficult-to-separate silhouette during the pivot, suggesting a small overlap but not establishing severe leg twisting or a temporal pop.

items.name: sit_stand
items.location: Skirt and petticoat around the seated thighs
items.issue: The seated phase holds the skirt in a wide, rigid bowl around the knees instead of draping over the thighs, consistent with absent physics, with no unequivocal pop visible in the closely spaced 54–60 samples.

items.name: spin
items.issue: The flared skirt maintains a uniformly stiff disk-like shape with little local folding, an expected unsimulated-cloth artifact, while the closely spaced samples show no clear geometry jump.

items.name: idol_dance
items.location: Lifted knee and skirt over the raised thigh
items.issue: The running-style accent shows a slightly pinched bent knee and a stiff skirt shelf over the raised thigh, with no clear deformation pop between frames 72 and 74.
